backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for a Hindu devotional app, defining types and state for festivals, mantras, aartis, shlokas, dharma quotes, temples, community posts, user profiles, jap counters, and kathayen, with access-controlled CRUD operations and admin helpers.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented feature IDs (UI redesign, page redesigns, component updates) to their affected files, component dependencies, and test IDs with confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON dictionary of short summaries for each frontend source file, describing the purpose and key implementation details of every component, page, hook, and config file in the project.
frontend/.env.example: Example environment file documenting the optional Google Gemini API key (stored client-side in localStorage) and noting that image generation uses the keyless Pollinations.ai service.
frontend/index.css: Root Tailwind CSS file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes covering background, foreground, card, primary, chart, and sidebar color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point that mounts the React app into a `#root` div and loads the TypeScript module entry point `src/main.tsx`.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes (Home, Panchang, Jap, Mandir, Profile, Community, Aarti, AartiDetail, AdminPanel, AIGuru, Kathayen, KathaDetail) wrapped in ThemeProvider and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AartiCard.tsx: Reusable card button component for displaying an aarti entry with a saffron/gold devotional style, deity tag, and navigation to the aarti detail route on click.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Main application layout component that renders the sticky header with logo/login, notification banner, bottom navigation, page outlet, and conditionally shows a profile setup modal for authenticated users without a profile.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with eight app sections (Home, Panchang, Jap, Aarti, etc.) using TanStack Router, highlighting the active route with saffron/gold styling.
frontend/src/components/ChatMessage.tsx: Renders a single chat message bubble for user or AI assistant, with text-to-speech controls (play/pause/stop) via useSpeechNarration and Hindi/Devanagari language detection.
frontend/src/components/ChatTypingIndica: Displays an animated three-dot typing indicator with an AI guru avatar, shown while the AI is generating a response.
frontend/src/components/DailyDharmaQuote: Shows a daily dharma quote card with Hindi and English text fetched via useGetDharmaQuote, falling back to a hardcoded Bhagavad Gita verse while loading.
frontend/src/components/EkadashiReminder: Displays a dismissible banner reminding users of upcoming Ekadashi fasting dates within a 7-day window, using a hardcoded 2026 date list and sessionStorage to track dismissal.
frontend/src/components/FestivalCountdow: Card component that shows a Hindu festival's name, description, and a live countdown in days, with a share button that uses the Web Share API or clipboard fallback.
frontend/src/components/FloatingLotus.ts: Decorative full-screen overlay that renders six floating lotus petal images with staggered CSS keyframe animations for ambient background effect.
frontend/src/components/GoldenHalo.tsx: Wrapper component that renders a pulsing radial golden glow halo around its children, with configurable size via numeric or named presets.
frontend/src/components/KathaCard.tsx: Renders a clickable card for a Hindu katha (story) displaying its title, a preview of the Hindi text, category label, deity name, and an emoji derived from the deity. Navigates to the katha detail page on click.
frontend/src/components/Loader.tsx: Displays a spinning mandala image with an Om symbol overlay as a loading indicator, with optional size and text props.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: A button that handles Internet Identity login and logout, clearing the React Query cache on logout and retrying login if already authenticated.
frontend/src/components/LotusBloomOverla: A full-screen animated overlay that appears when 108 japa counts are completed, showing a lotus image, petal burst particles, and a congratulatory message in Hindi.
frontend/src/components/MalaRing.tsx: Renders an animated canvas-based mala (prayer bead ring) with 108 beads, filling beads based on the count prop, with a slowly rotating ring and a breathing Om symbol at the center.
frontend/src/components/NotificationBann: Displays a styled in-app notification banner for namjap, aarti, or vrat reminders with a 10-second auto-dismiss progress bar and a manual close button.
Shows a brief burst animation of three Om (ॐ) symbols radiating outward from the center, auto-hiding after 700ms.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog prompting new users to enter their name to create a profile, submitting it via the useSetUserProfile mutation with a default mantra selection.
frontend/src/components/SacredRipple.tsx: Renders up to four concentric ripple ring animations centered on the component whenever the trigger prop changes, used as a tap feedback effect.
frontend/src/components/ShlokaCard.tsx: A React card component that displays a Sanskrit shloka with its Hindi and English meanings, including copy-to-clipboard and native share functionality with decorative styling.
frontend/src/components/VratModeDashboar: A dashboard component for fasting (vrat) mode that displays Brahma Muhurat times, countdown timers to upcoming Ekadashi and Shivratri dates, and vrat-related task checklists.
frontend/src/components/VratModeToggle.t: A toggle UI component that enables or disables 'Vrat Mode' (fasting mode), visually switching between active and inactive states with amber-themed styling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A custom React hook that creates and returns an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAIChat.ts: A custom React hook managing AI chat state, including sending messages, building conversation history, persisting chat to localStorage, and handling loading/error/retry states.
frontend/src/hooks/useDailyNotifications: A custom React hook that schedules seven daily browser notifications (or in-app banners) at fixed times for Nam Jap, Aarti, and Vrat reminders, with enable/disable and permission management.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook for ICP, managing login, logout, and identity persistence via DFINITY's AuthClient with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend actor interactions including user profile, jap counter, dharma quotes, festivals, and community posts, using tanstack/react-query for data fetching and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useSpeechNarration.ts: Custom React hook that wraps the Web Speech API to provide text-to-speech narration with play/pause/stop controls, smart voice selection for Hindi (Devanagari) and English content, and async voice loading support.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Poppins and Tiro Devanagari Hindi fonts, configures Tailwind CSS, defines a devotional saffron/gold light and dark theme via CSS custom properties, and declares spiritual-themed keyframe animations.
frontend/src/lib/aiEngine.ts: AI engine module that sends chat messages to the Pollinations.ai free API using a Hindu spiritual guide system prompt, with multiple fallback strategies (POST, GET, Mistral model) and retry logic for resilience.
frontend/src/lib/aiGuruData.ts: Static data module providing zodiac rashi definitions, daily horoscope prediction templates (love, career, etc.) per rashi, and TypeScript interfaces used by the AI Guru and Bhavishya (horoscope) features.
frontend/src/lib/kathaData.ts: Contains static data for Hindu religious stories (Kathas) including full Hindi texts of Ramayan and Mahabharat, typed as the Katha interface with metadata like category, deity, and approval status.
frontend/src/lib/panchangEngine.ts: Client-side astronomical calculation engine using Jean Meeus algorithms to compute Hindu calendar (Panchang) data including sun/moon longitudes, Julian day conversion, and related celestial positions for central India.
frontend/src/lib/staticData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and static data arrays for Shlokas and Aartis, including full Hindi and English texts for Ganesh, Shiv, Vishnu, and other deity aartis.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React application entry point that mounts the app with QueryClientProvider for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for ICP authentication.
frontend/src/pages/Aarti.tsx: Aarti collection listing page that displays a hero banner and a scrollable list of all aartis from static data using the AartiCard component.
frontend/src/pages/AartiDetail.tsx: Detail page for a single aarti that supports Hindi/English toggle, text-to-speech narration, copy to clipboard, and native share functionality.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin panel page that allows authenticated admins to manage user approvals, assign roles, and add Dharma quotes, with login-gating and role-checking guards.
frontend/src/pages/AIGuru.tsx: AI spiritual guide chat page (दिव्य गुरु) that renders a chat interface with suggested Hindi prompts, message history, typing indicator, and integrates the useAIChat hook for sending and managing messages.
frontend/src/pages/Community.tsx: Community page displaying spiritual posts from the backend alongside static seed posts, with support for creating, liking, and reporting posts via Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Simple dashboard page that fetches and displays the caller's user profile with a welcome message and navigation hints.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page featuring a hero banner with Panchang info, daily Dharma quote, featured shloka, and category navigation cards for mantras, aarti, puja, and bhajans.
frontend/src/pages/Jap.tsx: Jap counter page with a mala ring UI for tracking mantra repetitions, mala completions, daily/lifetime counts, and streak, persisted to localStorage.
frontend/src/pages/KathaDetail.tsx: Detail page for a single katha that renders its Hindi/English text, supports copy/share actions, and provides text-to-speech narration via a speech hook.
frontend/src/pages/Kathayen.tsx: Displays a filterable, searchable list of Hindu kathas (sacred stories) by merging static and backend data, with category tabs (all, puranik, vrat, krishna) and a search bar rendering results via KathaCard components.
frontend/src/pages/Mandir.tsx: Temple finder page that shows a list of static temple data, a Google Maps link to find nearby Hindu temples, and an animated sacred portal card linking to an external URL.
frontend/src/pages/Panchang.tsx: Hindu calendar page that displays daily panchang details (tithi, nakshatra, vara, yoga, karana, paksha) for a user-selected date with previous/next day navigation.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: User profile page showing jap stats, mantra selection, vrat mode toggle, and daily notification settings, syncing preferences with the backend user profile.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing functions to read, store, retrieve, and clear URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining a devotional Hindu color palette (saffron, gold, maroon, cream, warmYellow) plus semantic CSS variable tokens for background, foreground, card, primary, sidebar, and chart colors using oklch.
project_state.json: Project state document describing a Hindu devotional app redesign with saffron/gold/red-yellow theme, listing existing implemented features, architectural notes, required images, and known issues.
